items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: And Shirley Horn will be there and Plas Johnson, a great player.

ctx.x: Ah. What kind of ensemble do they put together for that? Is it a studio orchestra?
No, John Clayton/Jeff Hamilton Band, a big jazz band. And Shirley Horn will be there and Plas Johnson, a great player. I forget who else, but other people too, so that’ll be nice.
Did you ever play on rock stuff?
